finalists.label: Livedoid Vasculopathy
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings for it, including a reticular purplish livedo pattern and multiple chronic nonhealing ulcers.

finalists.label: Thrombophilia
finalists.why: It has multiple relevant findings, including thrombophilia and nonhealing ulcers, with no findings against it.

finalists.label: Chronic Venous Insufficiency
finalists.why: It explains the nonhealing ulcers and white atrophic scars, despite the livedo pattern being against it.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a reticular purplish livedo pattern and multiple chronic nonhealing ulcers specifically supports Livedoid Vasculopathy over the other finalists.
